title: Catheter Product Characteristics: Urological Supply Program
content:
Product characteristics of the six catheter programs in the Urological Supply Program: coating, latex content, sizing and program-entry documentation, and packaging.

| Program | Hydrophilic option | Latex-free catheter | French size change needs new written order | Criteria date rule on move into closed system | Unmarked packaging |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | no | no | yes | no | yes |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | no | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | no | yes | no | no | yes |

## Column definitions

- **Hydrophilic option** — whether a hydrophilic-coated catheter may be furnished under the code at no extra charge.
- **Latex-free catheter** — whether the program's catheter is latex-free.
- **French size change needs new written order** — whether a change of French size needs a new written order.
- **Criteria date rule on move into closed system** — whether a move into the closed-system program needs a criteria documentation date on or after the qualifying infections.
- **Unmarked packaging** — whether shipments go in unmarked packaging.

## Characteristics read by program

- A hydrophilic-coated catheter may be furnished at no extra charge only in the Straight Intermittent (A4351) and Coudé Tip (A4352) programs; the other four programs show no for this option.
- The Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) is the one program whose catheter is not latex-free; the All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) and the other four programs carry latex-free catheters.
- A change of French size needs a new written order in every program except the Male External Catheter Program (A4349).
- The criteria-date rule shows yes only for the Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353).
- Every program ships in unmarked packaging.
